milestone: R18 native selected-person properties, explicit paging, mode restore and custom semantics
outcome: Current standard13 and genuine sc-mod12 property browsing accepted in private desktop sessions; timely commit milestone, remaining HD goal active.
changes: Native version1 observer captures original selected-row/title draws with temporary owner/paint tickets and full U16 IDs; no property hook replay or world-rule edits.
Strict atomic bridge validates current menu/person/generation, raw GBK and bounded NUL strings, per-title/value flags and current revisions; actual empty values remain valid.
UI distinguishes current, previously read and unread native fields, uses one manual LEFT/RIGHT with real native ACK, and retires stale gestures across paint, overlays, identity and mode changes.
Classic/HD restoration recovers the same normal PERSON menu locally without reopening the native menu or sending input; existing march restore remains.

Current verified custom native fields replace fixed fifteen standard meanings in the visible core; name/portrait position preserved, raw fifteen retained in debug. Genuine sc-mod Age7 is native shield infantry rather than age.
Seven current engine entries share cache20261009y and preserve Module callbacks; no mobile HD implementation claim.
